_doc: Catalog of reusable house-style objects (MASTER_PROMPT_FINAL §24, §4). «kit» entries are builders in src/lib that any topic may use (they build a NEW object for the topic). «topic» entries are finished objects of one topic: another topic may import one only when `consent` lists that topic's slug, recorded after the user said yes (decisions.md). scripts/audit.mjs refuses a topic that imports another topic's code or the demo samples without it.

organic.what: capsule, loft, blob, petal: plants, animals, organs, cells

symbols.what: storm, tangle, bloom, sparks, trapdoor, levitation

nature.what: particles (smoke, steam, fire, drops, gas), vessel with liquid

units.what: unit grid: N identical bodies where N is the number said, a marked part in coral
